facts.business: NACL Industries Limited is a crop protection company with manufacturing capabilities, a diversified product portfolio, and a formulations business, now part of the Murugappa Group following Coromandel International's acquisition of a controlling stake.
key_risks: Concentration of sales to dealers/distributors (45% of total sales in FY26)
High related party transaction exposure (100% of loans/advances and investments with related parties)
Inherent limitations of internal financial controls including possibility of collusion or management override
Transition and integration risks following acquisition by Coromandel International/Murugappa Group
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include: Purchases 6% of total purchases (FY26), Sales 4% of total sales (FY26), Loans & advances 100% of total loans/advances, Investments 100% of total investments. Previous year: Purchases 9%, Sales 5%, Loans & advances 100%, Investments 100%.
